metadata.title: Power-Law Holographic Forces and Causal Transport in MERA Quantum Circuits
metadata.description: We report four results from classical simulation of critical transverse-field Ising model chains on up to 24 qubits establishing quantitative physical content in the MERA-AdS correspondence: (1) power-law holographic forces F(dr) ~ dr^{-alpha} with alpha = 3.92 +/- 0.16, consistent with stress-tensor exchange (alpha = 4); (2) holographic transport matching the AdS_3 null geodesic prediction to 0.72%; (3) a two-phase ALM + projection method for Z2-symmetric MERA optimization at 24 qubits; (4) chi=3 MERA overcoming the expressibility barrier to enable the first MERA-based holographic force measurement.
